race.comment: DARK AVALANCHE (7) is knocking on the door of another win, finishing 1.5L off the winner at Belmont last time out. He draws the inside now with Pike hopping on board back to a track and trip he's placed at previously. Should be hitting his peak now and a forward showing is on the cards. FRIAR'S LEGACY (3) was too good at Kalgoorlie last time out, winning by 1.7L as the race favourite at Kalgoorlie. Brad Parnham now takes the ride and he looks to get every chance from the draw. Should appreciate some sting out of the ground and he can repeat the dose. SANDFIRE ROSE (13) disappointed last start out to the mile and looks better placed coming back to this track and trip. She was trending the right way prior to that. Can bounce back to winning ways with Nottle back aboard. AIN'TSOBAD (6) gets the blinkers on first time today and can feature. STATE OF FURY (14) won't be far away.
